installs._comment: GET /download/<platform> (1.15.0): resolves the latest RokctAI/supacharge release through the public GitHub releases API and 302s to that platform's asset; the releases page when it cannot. No token, no environment.

Since 1.28.0 the living marketing calendar (Ray, 2026-09-11: "i want it alive like schedule move as time pass"): a server page that loads api.lms.marketing_calendar in the render (never in an effect) and draws where the school year is today, the next campaign window with its countdown, the upcoming windows with dates, countdown, theme and status badge, and the iCalendar feed to subscribe to. System Manager territory on the server; the host's LMS role gate answers first. The actions (app/actions/handson/all/lms/calendar/) and the service (app/services/all/lms/marketing-calendar.ts) ride the directory mappings above.

Since 1.25.0 the ONE curriculum line, "Built for CAPS, IEB and Cambridge", rendered from LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.subjects.curricula with base_sdk's MenuLabel pill after a name whose entry carries a badge (Ray, 2026-09-10: "add soon label in curriculum for cambridge"; Cambridge joins the line as the third curriculum, marked soon). The subjects section's eyebrow and the Subjects feature card's first list line both render it. No "use client": MenuLabel is a plain component, so the pill is in the server-rendered first HTML.

Since 1.26.0 the apps group is FIRST and laid out as ONE row (base_sdk 1.36.0's HeaderMenuGroup.layout) and the trigger word is declared as megaLabel: "Explore" (Ray, 2026-09-10: "header app links first. if possible put mobile apps in one row since supa dont have much menu"), so the panel leads with the three app cards side by side and Explore / Platform are the headed columns beside them; the bar still reads `[Explore v]  Pricing  FAQ`. Since 1.23.0 the section links are folded into the mega menu (Ray, 2026-09-10: "some of menus in header i think there should have gone to mega menu"): the bar reads `[Explore v]  Pricing  FAQ`, and the panel's groups are Explore (sessions, subjects, tutors - the trigger and the lead column), Platform (features, partners with its meta.nav badge) and Get the app (the cards). Each section entry is `{ anchor }`, resolved by base against the live nav, so labels and badges still come from meta.nav and pricing is still dropped when no plan renders.

Since 1.24.0 declares `brand: "stem"` (base_sdk 1.32.0's HeroConfig.brand): base's hero renders the site name's stem - brandStemOf(PLATFORM_NAME), the full name on aria-label and title - on the server, so the first HTML carries it and no client rewrite is needed.

1.24.0: the token class and the two font variables as one list (LMS_THEME_CLASSES) and joined (LMS_ROOT_CLASS), in a module with no "use client" directive so base_sdk 1.32.0's server render can read it through lms-theme-section.tsx's meta.rootClass; lms-theme.tsx's effect reads the same list for <html>.

Since 1.24.0 its effect adds only what <html> lacks of LMS_THEME_CLASSES (lms-theme-classes.ts, the one list lms-theme-section.tsx also declares as meta.rootClass) and it renders one <style> rule carrying --hero-chars - the hero stem's character count, derived from the name base renders (PLATFORM_NAME) by base_sdk 1.29.0's brandStemOf - that lms-theme.css sizes the stem from. 1.22.0's hero wordmark rewrite (lms-hero-wordmark.ts, a MutationObserver on the frame's span) is gone: base renders the stem itself.

Since 1.24.0 its meta declares rootClass: LMS_ROOT_CLASS, which base_sdk 1.32.0's server-rendered landing joins onto the landing root in the first HTML, so the no-JS render is themed. The module carries no "use client" directive since 1.24.0 (its component only renders the client LmsTheme): base reads meta on the server, where every export of a client module is a client reference whose properties read as undefined.

Since 1.27.0 the card has a founder role (the Flutter card's founder branch, tutor_card.dart): the Founder / Co-Founder badge, no grade badge, the bio alone on the back, "Hear more" playing the self-intro video in the card (disabled until the asset ships) and no Start button. Tutor and assistant cards are unchanged.

1.27.0: the founders as lms/dart's seeded_tutor_catalog.dart carries them (founder_ray_thompson: name, title line, subject, bio, portrait folder, intro video ref) - every string copied from the Dart source, held equal by tests/test_landing_apps.py; founderIntroVideo answers the video only once the generated team-assets.ts lists it.

_comment.about: Since 1.29.0 the header's stem wordmark is drawn in the brand face - the same family, style, weight and tracking as the hero wordmark - by one rule in lms-theme.css on base_sdk 1.40.0's `data-brand-wordmark="stem"` hook (Ray, 2026-09-11: the header's "Supacharge" was in the wrong font while the hero's and the footer's were right); the base_sdk floor for components/custom/header.tsx is 1.40.0 since 1.29.0. Since 1.27.0 the founder card reaches the company's about page (Ray, 2026-09-10: corporate_sdk owns /about and /team as renderers; Supacharge's about page reuses lms's existing founder card): components/custom/lms-founder-section.tsx registers in base_sdk's page-sections.ts registry with meta.page "about" (base_sdk 1.38.0's PageSectionMeta.page), so the landing never draws it and corporate_sdk's /about receives it through base's pageSectionsFor("about"); the card is lms-tutor-card.tsx's founder role, ported unchanged in look from lms/dart's tutor_card.dart founder branch, and the data is lms-founders.ts, every string copied from seeded_tutor_catalog.dart's founder_ray_thompson. The base_sdk floor for components/custom/landing/page-sections.ts is 1.38.0 since 1.27.0. Since 1.26.0 the header menu leads with the apps group in ONE row and declares the trigger word (base_sdk 1.36.0: HeaderMenuGroup.layout, HeaderMenu.megaLabel); the base_sdk floor for components/custom/landing/header-menu.ts and components/custom/header-menu.tsx is 1.36.0 since 1.26.0. Since 1.2.0 this half holds Supacharge's landing page sections and the page that serves `/` (Ray, 2026-09-03: each home SDK holds its own landing page, like profile in Dart; Ray, 2026-09-07: Supacharge's Flutter home SDK is lms so the same holds for Next.js - core/utils/flutter/composer/supacharge.json flags lms_sdk home_sdk: true). base_sdk >= 1.5.0 carries only the generic landing host (app/landing/page.tsx, components/custom/landing-content.tsx, the page-sections.ts registry, the hero) and this SDK registers its floating nav, sessions, subjects, tutors, features, partners, pricing, faq, testimonials and footer sections into it, one integrations line each at the // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start marker, in page order (the installer anchors each line after the previous one). Their copy is components/custom/landing/lms-landing-config.ts, every claim sourced from the Flutter app's tour guide and strings, the tutor roster, the CAPS lesson pipeline and the product docs; facts no source carries are [[PLACEHOLDER]] tokens listed in LMS_LANDING_PLACEHOLDERS. app/page.tsx is the counterpart of agent_sdk's app/(chat)/page.tsx: anonymous visitors redirect to /landing, signed-in users to the lms home; it reads the session through base_sdk's kernel seam so it works with or without auth_sdk. It lands on the shell's own app/page.tsx (the composer overwrites shell copies, as base_sdk's host files do), so an uncomposed shell keeps its own `/`. base_sdk composes first. Since 1.2.0 it also fills the hero itself (Ray, 2026-09-08: the base_sdk hero is a frame whose body the home SDK injects through a registry, like the landing sections; the chat box belongs to agent_sdk): lms-hero-form.tsx registers at // @rokct-sdk-hero-form-start in base_sdk >= 1.7.0's hero-form.ts (two calls to action, no input) and lms-hero-copy.ts at // @rokct-sdk-hero-copy-start in base_sdk >= 1.6.0's hero-copy.ts (Supacharge's words over HERO_CONFIG; draft copy pending Ray's approval). Since 1.2.0 the tutors and pricing sections render the app's cards (Ray, 2026-09-08: bring the tutor and subscription cards to nextjs so their images show and they flip): lms-tutor-card.tsx and lms-plan-card.tsx over the lms-flip-card.tsx primitive (rotateY flip on click / Enter / Space, hover on fine pointers, crossfade under prefers-reduced-motion), the portraits from templates/public/team (installed at public/team, served at /team/...) through the generated team-assets.ts manifest - both written by lms/dart/tool/sync_team_assets.dart, the same tool and CI workflow that vendors lms/team into the Dart half's assets/team (Ray: if in dart assets are in lms, they should also be in lms in nextjs). Since 1.2.0 the landing also carries Supacharge's own look (Ray, 2026-09-08: give it its own feel like the Dart Supacharge app): components/custom/landing/lms-theme.css holds the Dart AppStyle tokens (primary #FF6600, surface #101010, card #1C1C1C, stroke #2E2E2E, ink #FFFFFF / #8C8C8C; the light set behind html.sc-landing:not(.dark), the same class Tailwind’s dark: variants read, so the host’s theme toggle drives both at once) and the shared card/chip/badge/button shapes; lms-fonts.ts loads Inter and Montserrat through next/font/google (the same Google families the Dart app fetches through google_fonts; no bundled font files); lms-theme.tsx puts the tokens and the font variables on <html> while the landing is mounted, defaults the mode to `dark` only when the host has not set one (1.5.2), and is registered first through lms-theme-section.tsx (order -2); lms-wordmark.tsx is the Dart wordmark (Montserrat Black Italic + the registered mark) traced to one SVG path, also installed as public/brand/supacharge-wordmark(.svg|-ink.svg). Every lms section, the hero body and the floating nav read those tokens; base_sdk's hero frame, which hard-codes its colours and a fixed 250px wordmark slot, is re-painted from lms-theme.css through its #hero id until the frame grows a hook (see CHANGELOG 1.2.0). Since 1.5.1 Pricing is a floating-nav stop again (Ray, 2026-09-08: "pricing not injected so floating nav doesnt have it"). It had none because the section hides itself when the platform returns no plan rows and a static meta.nav would have left a tick scrolling nowhere; base_sdk >= 1.11.0 takes a meta.renders predicate over the page facts, so lms-pricing.tsx now carries a real {id: "pricing", label: "Pricing"} entry plus renders: ({plans}) => showsPricing(plans) - the one predicate its own render guard uses - and the host drops the section and the stop together when there is nothing to price. Since 1.7.0 it also answers the header half of Ray's "menus in header and footer are not injected". The footer half was never missing - lms-footer-section.tsx has rendered LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.footer.links (Sessions, Subjects, Tutors, Partners, FAQ plus the auth links and the app link) since this SDK shipped its footer - but supacharge.app's HEADER carried only the wordmark, the theme toggle and the two auth links, because components/custom/header.tsx is the host shell's own file (base_sdk `requires`) and no SDK may ship it. base_sdk 1.13.0 added the seam: components/custom/landing/lms-header-menu.ts is registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-header-menu-start and names SECTION IDS - sessions, subjects, tutors, features, partners, pricing, faq - not hrefs and not labels, so the word on screen and the Partners NEW badge come from each section's own meta.nav and there is no second list to fall out of step. base_sdk resolves them against the page's live nav, so `pricing` disappears from the header on a render where lms-pricing.tsx's `renders` predicate turns the section down rather than linking to an absent anchor. `testimonials` is deliberately not in the menu while that section still shows [[TESTIMONIAL_n_QUOTE]] placeholder copy, and no fixed `links` are declared: sign-in and sign-up already sit in the host header beside the row, and the app download (LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.app) points off-site to a releases page the footer already carries. Since 1.8.0 most of the landing's card sections are ONE swipeable row below 640px rather than a column of cards (Ray, 2026-09-09: "actually most cards should be one row in mobile. even subjects cards", because "im avoiding a long scroll"): components/custom/landing/lms-theme.css carries one .sc-row class - the same snap row .sc-deck already is, as a class rather than the lms-card-deck.tsx component, so a section keeps its own markup, its own card components and a tap that still flips a plan card - and the features, subjects, pricing, session-steps, testimonials and partners grids each add it. The rules sit in a single @media (max-width: 639.98px) block and every converted section is pixel-identical from 640px up, measured at six viewports; the grids drop the grid-cols-1 they no longer need and the md:-breakpoint ones pin sm:grid-cols-1 in its place to hold the 640-767px band. Left stacked: the session FACTS (paragraphs, not cards), the FAQ accordion and the footer link list. Also in 1.8.0 the testimonials row carries FIVE items instead of three (Ray, 2026-09-09: "i need you to add 2 more so when i replace i will replace all. right now is about the design") - all five are PLACEHOLDER stand-ins, first names and roles only, and LMS_LANDING_PLACEHOLDERS names all five and asks for all five to be replaced. The tutors section was already the deck. No base_sdk change and no new file: base_sdk holds only the landing HOST, so a card section's layout is this SDK's own, and rokct.ai's sections are agent_sdk's separate copies - this does not reach them. Since 1.9.0 the copy covers IEB as well as CAPS (Ray, 2026-09-09: "its joining it. though i havent added tutors and assistants of IEB but since ieb extends caps i can use same team"). IEB schools sit the NSC on the same DBE CAPS curriculum - factory/lessons/curriculum/IEB/README.md: "the IEB teaches the same CAPS content", what differs is assessment (the per-subject SAGs) - so the subjects eyebrow reads "Built for CAPS and IEB", the subjects blurb and the What-is-Supacharge answer name the shared curriculum, the Subjects feature card drops the curriculum word it did not need, and one new FAQ item, "Does this work for IEB?", says so plainly and ends by stating that IEB past papers are not included. The claim is deliberately held to SHARED CURRICULUM CONTENT and nothing else: there is no IEB assessment layer in the product - the published lesson indexes carry zero IEB rows, the index builders are pointed at the CAPS root and lms_course has no curriculum field - and the company does not hold permission to reproduce IEB past papers (Ray, 2026-09-09: "we cant do practice as we dont have permission for past papers for IEB"; factory/lessons/curriculum/IEB/SOURCES.md carries the commercial-use flag behind that). So nothing here says IEB-aligned, offers IEB past papers, or implies an IEB-specific lesson set, and no IEB mark or weighting figure appears. The closing clause states an absence, not a plan: it says the papers are not included rather than "not yet", because a promise of assessment material the company has no permission to reproduce would be its own untruth. The team is unchanged on Ray's own say-so: the CAPS tutors, assistants and schedule serve both, and lms/team/**/CAPS/ stays as it is - those paths are identifiers read by sync_team_assets.dart, build_tutor_catalog.py and the live /team/... image URLs, not copy. The Dart half carries the same two strings in templates/tour/lms.tour.yaml (manifest 1.16.8), reworded identically so the guided tour and the site do not diverge. Since 1.10.0 the testimonials are rokct.ai's auto-scrolling row (Ray, 2026-09-09: Supacharge is to inherit rokct.ai's auto-scrolling testimonials): lms-testimonials-section.tsx keeps its frame and heading and renders base_sdk >= 1.14.0's components/custom/landing/testimonials-marquee.tsx over LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.testimonials, with the card re-themed through the marquee's cardClassName prop (sc-card, the same p-6, the 350px width the track needs) and the edge fades through fadeClassName (from-[var(--sc-card-alt)], the section's ground); the words inside the card, which the marquee paints zinc with no prop to change, are re-painted with the card's ink from lms-theme.css through the sc-marquee/sc-marquee-card classes the section adds, the way the hero frame is. A [[TOKEN]] quote is still shown bare, never wrapped in quotation marks. The .sc-row swipe row is gone from this one section because the marquee is one horizontal row at every width. Also in 1.10.0 the new/soon pill lms-floating-nav.tsx draws is base's ONE components/custom/menu-label.tsx (bg-primary, black text) instead of its own --sc-primary span, so the nav and the header - base's since 1.14.0, with this SDK's lms-header-menu.ts rendered inside it - can never show two different labels; and components/custom/landing/lms-site-metadata.ts registers Supacharge's <title>, description, tagline, keywords, locale and wordmark at base_sdk 1.15.0's // @rokct-sdk-site-metadata-start marker (components/custom/landing/site-metadata.ts) with one integrations line. That last file is optional in the base floor: against 1.14.0 the installer prints 'Integration target not found' and skips the line, which is why lms-site-metadata.ts declares the shape it fills itself instead of importing base's SiteMetadataCopy (an import of a file that is not on disk would fail the build). The base_sdk floor is 1.14.0 since 1.10.0: the header that renders the menu, menu-label.tsx and the marquee ship together there. Since 1.11.0 the social card carries a still of the app (Ray, 2026-09-09: the link preview shows a still from the tour, not only the wordmark): lms-site-metadata.ts registers still: /brand/social-still.png and stillAnchor: bottom for base_sdk >= 1.16.0's two-column preview (the tour frame 372px wide in a phone bezel on the right, hung 72px under the top edge and bleeding off the bottom so the screen's header shows); the file is templates/public/brand/social-still.png, a 744px-wide lossless downscale of ONE chapter of the app's guided tour - marketing/tour/screenshots/06-schedule.png in RokctAI/supacharge, the Today-sorted schedule screen - written by lms/team/scripts/tour_still.py, which .github/workflows/sync_team_assets.yml runs ahead of the persona sync with the chapter named by its single STILL_CHAPTER value (the canonical copy sits in lms/team/marketing/tour/renders/, under the marketing root the persona sync excludes so the still never reaches the Flutter bundle; its README says how to flip the chapter, and that a bottom-sheet chapter such as 02-auth_login needs stillAnchor: top). The base_sdk floor stays 1.14.0 - the still is an addition base ignores below 1.16.0, not a break. Since 1.12.0 the landing shows the app's downloads as TWO entries (Ray, 2026-09-09: "supacharge need to show these apps, ios is demoted for now. apk and desktop app"): components/custom/landing/lms-landing-config.ts carries LMS_APPS, one LandingApp per platform with label, description, icon (base's HeaderMenuIcon) and a `shown` flag - android ("Android app (APK)", the app-v<version>.apk the release lane attaches), desktop ("Desktop app", the app-windows-v<version>.zip the same lane attaches with build_windows: true; there is no macOS or Linux build) and ios, kept in the list with shown: false and a "demoted for now" comment because no iOS lane or listing exists - and LMS_SHOWN_APPS is the filtered list every surface reads: lms-header-menu.ts adds ONE group, labelled with the landing's "Get the app", whose items are the shown apps so base_sdk >= 1.18.0 draws them as cards (icon, label, blurb) in the header's panel and under one heading in the burger; lms-hero-form.tsx renders one button per shown app (APK primary, desktop outlined) ahead of sign-in; lms-footer-section.tsx one link per shown app in place of the single "Get the app". Every destination is still the releases PAGE, https://github.com/RokctAI/supacharge/releases/latest, for 1.4.1's reason (per-version asset names, no stable download URL); LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.app stays as the flagged, no-longer-rendered single link. The base_sdk floor is 1.18.0 since 1.12.0: HeaderMenuLink.description and .icon and the groups panel that draws them ship there, and against 1.14.0-1.17.0 the two fields are type errors. Also since 1.12.0 the web does NOT play lessons (Ray, 2026-09-09: "supacharge web doesnt play lessons or whatch libray but you should be able to watch schedule if you are logged in. for attending lessons it should ask you to download app on phone or download desktop app", because "we make things to apps so it will mean waiting on downloading those assets to users browser before play"): app/handson/all/lms/courses/[courseName]/learn/[lessonId]/page.tsx still resolves (the learn/ layout 404s only for a missing course) but renders components/custom/lms-download-app.tsx - the same two LMS_SHOWN_APPS as buttons under the landing's "Get the app" heading - and the react-player page it used to be is moved whole to learn/[lessonId]/_components/lesson-playback.tsx, flagged NOT USED ON THE WEB and imported by nothing. There is no library/watch route in this half, so nothing else was replaced. The schedule on the web is the lms home (app/handson/all/lms/page.tsx, LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.home.url) with its Upcoming Live Classes from lms.lms.api.get_my_live_classes; it and every lesson route sit under /handson, which auth_sdk's middleware matcher gates (auth.config.ts: isOnHandsOn && !isLoggedIn -> false), so no new gate was added. Gaps left, not built: the Flutter schedule reads replay.api.get_upcoming_sessions (replay/frappe/src/tenant/replay/api/get_upcoming_sessions.py), a different feed from the web dashboard's; there is no partner-students view and no signed-in billing/pay page on the web (paying is the landing's pricing -> LANDING_CONFIG.planSignupUrl); profile/details update (me/profile, updateProfileAction) exists and is untouched. Since 1.14.0 the tutor cards keep scrolling like the testimonials (Ray, 2026-09-09: "tutor cards should keep scrolling like testamonials"): from 640px up lms-tutors-section.tsx renders the roster, and the assistants under it, in components/custom/landing/lms-marquee.tsx - the same row base_sdk >= 1.14.0's testimonials-marquee.tsx is, with the card left to the caller because base's component draws its own quote card from an items list and has no slot for the flip card: the same clipping frame, edge fades and w-max track, the same `rokct-marquee` / `rokct-marquee-track` / `group-hover:[animation-play-state:paused]` classes, and base's app/styles/rokct-marquee.css imported by the same path (now in `requires`), so the keyframes, the pause under the pointer and the stillness under prefers-reduced-motion are base's one rule set and nothing is copied out of it; the track is measured and --rokct-marquee-duration set so the row moves at the testimonials' own pace (1850px a minute) rather than at their per-loop duration, and a row whose one copy of cards is narrower than its frame (the three assistants on a wide screen, or a short roster) stands still and centred as a single copy, never blank, becoming a marquee again where it overflows. BELOW 640px the roster is the deck exactly as 1.3.0 left it (Ray, 2026-09-08: one swipeable row, the next card's edge showing, dots under it): both rows are in the DOM and the breakpoint picks one, so nothing shifts on hydration; a visitor who asked for reduced motion gets the deck at every width, the still hand-scrolled row the marquee's own reduced-motion rule promises. The testimonials section still renders base's component, unchanged; no base_sdk change and the base floor stays 1.21.0. Since 1.15.0 the hero's download buttons are store badges (Ray, 2026-09-09: "rokct has platform logos but supacharge doesnt in those app buttons"; "its saying apk which it should not"; "supacharge must lose signin button in hero"): lms-hero-form.tsx renders one badge per LMS_SHOWN_APPS entry - the platform's mark from components/custom/landing/lms-app-glyphs.tsx (Android and Windows as single currentColor paths; lucide has no brand marks and base's image badges want a file), then the entry's eyebrow ("Download for") over its new `platform` field ("Android", "Windows") - and no sign-in button (the header carries sign-in). No rendered word says APK: the android entry is "Android app" / "Direct download for Android from the latest release", and the header's app cards, the footer links and the lesson prompt read the same fields. The shown entries' hrefs are the site's own /download/android and /download/windows (Ray: "there is no way we can resolve to get the direct download link?"): templates/app/download/[platform]/route.ts asks the public GitHub releases API for the latest release (fetch with next.revalidate 600, no token - the repository is public), app/download/[platform]/resolve.ts picks the platform's asset by its name pattern (app-v<version>.apk, not the debug build or the .aab; app-windows-v<version>.zip, not update_package.zip) and the route 302s to it, to the releases page when the API fails or has no such asset, 404 for a platform nothing publishes (iOS), 204 to a prefetch so no router warms a 127 MB download. The entries stay external: true so every surface renders a plain anchor, never a prefetching Link.
